class.name: OcgGraphic3dCubemaporder
class.brief_description: Graphic3d_CubeMapOrder maps sides of cubemap on tiles in packed cubemap image to support different tiles order in such images. Also it can be considered as permutation of numbers from 0 to 5. It stores permutation in one integer as convolution.
class.description: ! Graphic3d_CubeMapOrder maps sides of cubemap on tiles in packed cubemap image ! to support different tiles order in such images. ! Also it can be considered as permutation of numbers from 0 to 5. ! It stores permutation in one integer as convolution.

method.name: default
method.description: Default constructor. Creates empty order with zero convolution.

method.name: Set_2
method.description: Sets number of tile in packed cubemap image according passed cubemap side.

method.name: Swap
method.description: Swaps values of two cubemap sides.

method.name: Swapped
method.description: Returns copy of current order with swapped values of two cubemap sides.

method.name: Get
method.description: Returns value of passed cubemap side.

method.name: HasOverflows
method.description: Checks whether attempts to assign index greater than 5 to any side happed.

method.name: IsValid
method.description: Checks whether order is valid. Order is valid when it doesn't have repetitions and there were not attempts to assign indexes greater than 5.
